Rahul S/O. Bharat Jaiswal And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra
on 7 July, 2020

Author: M.G. Sewlikar
Bench: M.G. Sewlikar
 -1-
 In The High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Anticipatory
Bail Application No. 342 Of 2020
1. Rahul s/o Bharat Jaiswal

2 . Shikh Azahar Shaikh Raju Applicants
 Versus
The State of Maharashtra Respondent
Mr. A.K. Bhosle, Advocate for the applicants.
Mr. S.R. Yadav Lonikar, App for respondent.

Coram : M.G. Sewlikar, J.
 Date : 7th July, 2020.

Per Court :
1. Heard Mr. A.K. Bhosle, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. S.R. Yadav Lonikar, learned
App for the State.
2. Issue notice to respondent returnable on 21st July, 2020.
Learned APP waives service of notice on behalf of respondent.
3. The First Information Report was registered under Sections 188, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(1), 26(2)(IV), 27(E) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
All these offences are bailable.
Subsequently, the investigation agency has added Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code, which is non-bailable.
It appears that all the packets of banned material have been seized and therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicants does not appear to be necessary.
Hence, I am inclined to grant interim protection to the applicants.

Hence the following order :-

sentences.text:
The applicants be released on interim bail on executing PR bond of Rs.15,000/-
each with one solvent surety each in the like amount, in the event of their arrest in connection with Crime No. 0053/2020 registered with Sadar Bazar Police Station,
Dist. Jalna, for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(1), 26(2)(IV), 27(E) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, on condition that they shall not tamper the prosecution evidence,
shall not interfere in the investigation and, shall remain present in the police station as and when called by the concerned Investigating Offcer.
